security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Serial, SSH, Telnet and raw TCP terminal
bundle.longDescription: TermWorker is a terminal for people who bring up boards, modems and routers. It opens Serial, SSH, Telnet and raw TCP consoles in tabs, reconnects USB-serial adapters by itself, transfers files with X/Y/ZMODEM (including to U-Boot), and shows RFC 1662 HDLC frames in a side panel.
